$comment: Timeouts and batch size for the Event Markets resolution cron (api/_lib/event-markets/lifecycle.js). A market whose source has not produced a result this many hours after resolves_at is voided and every pick refunded. Documented in docs/event-markets.md, section How markets resolve.

void_reasons.resolution_timeout: The data source did not produce a result before the timeout, so the market was voided and every pick refunded.
